wiki.title: Ron Weinberg
wiki.extract: Ron Weinberg is a state representative from Loveland, Colorado. A Republican, Weinberg represents Colorado House of Representatives District 51, which includes a portion of Larimer County, Colorado, including the city of Loveland.
